purpose: High-value soft-blocked opportunities preserved for owner human review. This queue never bypasses explicit no-contact/no-freelance/no-agency/legal/dedup constraints.

items.evidence_summary: Recurring P.IVA / WordPress-infrastructure signal. Owner subsequently submitted a spontaneous application manually; no new FIRST_CONTACT is permitted through another route.
items.why_high_value: Very strong recurring P.IVA demand, WordPress and infrastructure overlap, high economic/continuity potential.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not initiate a new FIRST_CONTACT through another route.
Any future action must be a policy-compliant continuation after reply/state checks.
recommended_human_checks: Wait for reply; re-check only if a legitimate continuation is later indicated.
items.source_task: VDS Performance + Reply Watch deterministic reconciliation

items.evidence_summary: Explicit freelance-developer opportunity with an official application form.
items.why_high_value: Explicit freelance demand, strong WordPress/web fit, high recurring potential and an official application route.
safe_alternative_angles: Complete the official application form manually with the best-fit Italian CV/portfolio.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Use the official form; do not replace it with a generic email merely for automation convenience.
recommended_human_checks: Confirm form is still accepting applications.

items.evidence_summary: Fresh P.IVA developer demand with an official application form; role includes senior-level requirements that need human fit assessment.
items.why_high_value: Current P.IVA demand and good web-development overlap, with potential for recurring technical collaboration.
safe_alternative_angles: Manually apply if the senior requirements can be met truthfully.
If the form allows contextual notes, position VDS as an external P.IVA collaborator focused on matching web/frontend/performance capabilities rather than claiming unsupported senior stack depth.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not overclaim seniority or unsupported technologies.
Do not substitute a generic contact route for the official form without independent authority.
recommended_human_checks: Compare every mandatory senior requirement against the CV.
Identify which requirements are essential versus preferred.

items.evidence_summary: Fresh freelance/web-design signal with platform-only application route.
items.why_high_value: Current freelance model, remote accessibility and meaningful web/design fit; automation is blocked only by the platform route.
safe_alternative_angles: Apply manually through Mindrift's official platform if the current project/role remains aligned.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not send the application to support/legal/generic email as a substitute for the platform.
recommended_human_checks: Check current project availability and compensation/commitment terms.
Select the most relevant profile/category on the platform.

items.evidence_summary: Strong VDS fit and recurring freelance WordPress/technical-SEO history, but the specific external-demand signal is approximately six months old; current official email route exists.
items.why_high_value: Very high technical fit (94) and recurring/economic potential (95) with a current official company contact route; the only major weakness is freshness of the freelance-demand evidence.
safe_alternative_angles: First search for fresh evidence that UGECE still uses freelance WordPress/SEO collaborators.
If no fresh vacancy exists but the official site clearly supports business enquiries, consider a neutral B2B availability/overflow proposal that does not claim they are currently hiring freelancers.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not state that a current freelance opening exists unless reverified.
Do not treat historical LinkedIn demand as current fact.
recommended_human_checks: Review latest careers/LinkedIn/company posts for renewed freelance demand.
Confirm the business email is appropriate for a B2B partnership approach.
Decide whether the historical recurring pattern justifies a low-pressure overflow pitch.
